_help: nullCAT starting points: for each type of car, the haptics settings that depend on the type (how the tyres let go, how stiff the suspension is, how hard the kerbs and bumps hit, the brakes). Applying one from the Master tile of the Haptics strip sets only the settings listed here: routes, master gain, the position budget, the settings the car table owns (the engine, limiter, driveline, ABS and TC ones) and every setting not listed stay as they are. Pick the type closest to your car, apply it, then pull the car from the car table for its engine, gearbox, ABS and TC. Tile and setting names are the ones in rig.json's haptics object. Do not edit this file: it is replaced by every update.

Road car.description: Street car on road tyres: soft, long-travel suspension, progressive slides, iron brakes. Tuned on Assetto Corsa.

Cup car.description: One-make racer on semi-slicks (Porsche Cup, Ginetta, classic touring): firmer, slides earlier, still forgiving. Tuned on Assetto Corsa.

GT3 / GT.description: GT3, GTE and prototypes on slicks: stiff, aero, sharp slides, steel brakes. The middle ground to tune from. Tuned on Assetto Corsa.

Open wheeler.description: Single-seaters and formula cars on slicks: very stiff, little travel, grip lets go at small slip angles, carbon brakes. Tuned on Assetto Corsa.

Road car (AMS2).description: Road car for Automobilista 2: the same, with the slides sized to its tyres, which reach their grip at larger slip angles.
